answer: To forge a thousand fake agents, an attacker must post a thousand separate collateral bonds, each vesting only across a multi-month horizon while its attestation weight ramps slowly from zero. Identity is not a free jetty you step onto; it is a pier built plank by plank with locked capital. An honest agent bonds once and amortizes; a sybil farm bonds N times and waits N horizons, so the marginal cost of each extra identity never collapses to zero.
